title: Staff Analytics Analyst, Full Stack (Revenue)
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Team

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

What You’ll Do


Lead high-impact data product initiatives for Revenue, from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, implementation, rollout, and adoption.
Advance AI initiatives within the Revenue data ecosystem by identifying high-value use cases, integrating AI into analytics engineering workflows, and establishing the semantic, metadata, context, quality, and evaluation foundations required for AI.
Design and build durable, well-tested data products that power revenue operations, field and executive reporting, external merchant reporting, and analyst self-service.
Set technical direction for Revenue’s data layer across dbt models, metrics, semantic structures, documentation, lineage, testing, governance, and access controls.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale Revenue Analytics through improved data architecture, tooling, governance, and enablement.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to analysts and cross-functional partners, raising the bar for how data products are designed, built, and maintained.


What We Look For


7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.
Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, data modeling, metrics design, data quality, documentation, and modern analytics engineering practices.
Strong working knowledge of BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, or Tableau, cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.
Experience designing scalable data products for multiple audiences and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture and product direction.
Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial, GTM, revenue, or sales operations teams.


Pay Grade - O

Equity Grade - 12

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $220,000 - $280,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $195,000 - $255,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
company: TGH Senior Center Powered by Greenbrook Medical
description:
About Us

Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care.

We deliver high-touch, relationship-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care.

We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 90, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations.

Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors.

About The Role

We're hiring our first dedicated data person. This person will build on our existing data platform, harden it to ensure consistent performance and build upon our metric library to ensure that our operators can monitor performance across all of our levers.

Success in this role means end to end ownership, from data platform to metric delivery and visualization in dashboarding tools

As Senior Analytics Engineer, You Own Four Things


The analytics layer: the dbt models and business logic that turn raw data into something usable, and the metric definitions underneath them
Reporting and BI: the reporting layer the whole business reads from
Our production systems: you take ownership of systems as they come in-house from our engineering partner, harden them, and keep making them better, with accountability for uptime & system integrity
The partnership with our engineering team: you are the internal counterpart who knows both the business and the systems well enough to resolve most issues directly


This is a build-and-own role. Our engineering partner stands up a new capability; you take it on once it is live, harden it, and keep improving it. You work as their peer rather than their coordinator. You also partner closely with the pop health team (who owns our value drivers) in defining metrics and deciding together what the business needs to see. You report to the VP of Growth and Population Health.

Location: New York City strongly preferred (Hybrid). Open to exceptional remote candidates.

What You'll Do

Own the Analytics Layer


Build and maintain the dbt models and business logic our metrics and workflows depend on. Work within Google Cloud to iterate on our business logic and transformation infrastructure
Ensure consistency in definitions across all surfaces at Greenbrook
Work with the performance managers on what needs measuring and what good looks like in their areas


Take Ownership of What's in Production


Take on systems as they move from our engineering partner into steady state, and keep them healthy
Be accountable for uptime & system integrity – catch ingestion and pipeline issues or logic bugs and resolve them within our SLAs. Develop monitoring and uptime reporting.
Ensure a performant system. Optimize workloads and runtime
Keep improving what you take on rather than only maintaining it


Partner Across the Business


Be the counterpart our engineering partner can hand production work to, resolving what you can and escalating what needs them
Build dashboards to support organizational decision making
Work closely with the business – sit in the operating meetings where the data gets used, so you know what decisions it feeds


What Success Looks Like


Data Trust: the business trusts the numbers, and you are ahead of issues rather than behind them
Reliability: systems transitioned to you stay healthy, and when they break they get fixed quickly
Coverage: the metrics our drivers depend on have a certified definition and a single source of truth
Delivery: the work you committed to for the quarter shipped
Metrics you'll own: delivery against committed quarterly work, and counterpart satisfaction among the performance managers and the Head of Population Health


About You

You bring:


Fluency in dbt and Python
Hands on experience with Health care datasets and interoperability frameworks which our business run on, including a deep understanding of claims, eligibility, EHR data, and frameworks such as FHIR and HL7
A solid grasp of business fundamentals, enough to partner with business and clinical managers on defining metrics rather than only building to spec
Experience owning production systems, including being the person who responds when something breaks
Bachelor's degree required
A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork


You'll Stand Out If You


Want to own a system deeply: you would rather take something into production, harden it, and keep improving it than move on to the next greenfield build
Get to root cause: you find out why a number is wrong rather than patching the symptom
Are AI-native: you live in modern AI tools to support your work
Communicate with clarity: you are comfortable explaining complex data to business users and communicate proactively
Own the outcome: high bias for action, follow through on commitments, and close loops without needing to be chased


Why You'll Love Working Here

Make An Impact Every Day

Be part of a mission-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare.

Work That Actually Matters

We're not a volume-driven system, we're accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered.

Build And Grow With Us

We're building more than a company, we're building careers. As we expand, you'll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges.

Strong, Transparent Compensation & Benefits


$170,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications
Generous annual performance bonus
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off
401(k) with company match


Our Selection Process

Application → Initial interview → Skills/experience interview → Values interview → Case Study and Case Study Interview → References

Equal Employment Opportunity and Commitment to Diversity

At Greenbrook Medical, we believe the only way we accomplish our mission is by building the best team in healthcare. We do this through a culture of respect and belonging, ensuring our teammates feel cared for first and foremost.

We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. We encourage all who share our mission to apply. Greenbrook Medical will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. If you need additional accommodations or assistance, do not hesitate to contact our People team at recruiting@greenbrookmedical.com.

description:

title: Founding Data & Analytics Engineer
description:

America is undergoing one of the largest demographic shifts in its history as the Baby Boomer generation enters its later years. This shift will put unprecedented pressure on Medicare, which already spends more than $1 trillion each year caring for older adults. Yet the healthcare system is built backwards: reactive instead of preventative, measuring years of life instead of the quality of them.

Sailor Health is building a new care model for aging. We combine behavioral health, healthcare advocacy, wellness classes, and AI care agents into one virtual platform designed for older adults. AI coaches help patients navigate their health between visits, while AI copilots give providers the tools to deliver higher-quality, better-informed care. Have 3-10 years of experience in data engineering or analytics

title: MicroStrategy BI Data Engineer – Front Office Investment Data
description:
MicroStrategy BI Data Engineer – Front Office Investment Data

Company Overview:

Business Integration Partners (BIP) is Europe’s fastest growing digital consulting company and are on track to reach the Top 20 by 2030, with an expanding global footprint in the US (New York, Charlotte, Chicago, and Houston). Operating at the intersection of business and technology, we design, develop, and deliver sustainable solutions at pace and scale, creating greater value for our customers, employees, shareholders, and society.

BIP specializes in high-impact consulting services across multiple industries with 6,000 employees worldwide. Our Financial Services business serves Capital Markets, Insurance and Payments verticals, supplemented with Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance, Change Management and Digital Transformation practices. We integrate deep industry expertise with business, technology, and quantitative disciplines to deliver high-impact results for our clients.

BIP is currently expanding its footprint in the United States, focusing on growing its Capital Markets and Financial Services lines. Our teams operate at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and data to help our clients drive smarter decisions, reduce risks, and stay ahead in a fast-evolving market environment.

We are seeking a hands-on Senior MicroStrategy BI Data Engineer to design, build, and enhance enterprise data and business intelligence solutions supporting Portfolio Management, Trading, Risk Analytics, and other front-office investment teams.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, business intelligence, investment data, analytics, and enterprise reporting. The successful candidate will work across the data lifecycle—from source ingestion and transformation through Snowflake data models, curated datasets, semantic layers, MicroStrategy applications, dashboards, reporting, and analytics consumption.

The ideal candidate combines strong MicroStrategy development and architecture experience with advanced SQL, data engineering, Python, and investment-management domain knowledge.

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring an individual who can understand complex financial data, design scalable analytical data structures, build intuitive BI solutions, troubleshoot performance issues across multiple layers, and partner directly with Portfolio Managers, Traders, Risk professionals, and technology teams.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and support MicroStrategy-based BI and analytics solutions for Portfolio Management, Trading, Risk, Operations, and other investment-management users.
Build dashboards, dossiers, reports, analytics applications, and self-service reporting capabilities using MicroStrategy.
Design and maintain the MicroStrategy semantic layer, including attributes, facts, metrics, hierarchies, filters, prompts, transformations, and related metadata objects.
Translate complex front-office business requirements into scalable BI, reporting, and data solutions.
Work with investment datasets including: Positions and holdings, Transactions and investment activity, Security and instrument master data, Pricing and valuations, Market data, Reference data, Accounts and portfolios, Investment structures

Optimize MicroStrategy reports, dashboards, cubes, SQL generation, database queries, and Snowflake workloads for performance and scalability.
Investigate reporting discrepancies by tracing data from MicroStrategy through the semantic layer, database models, transformations, and upstream source systems.
Develop and maintain data-quality and reconciliation controls to ensure BI outputs are complete, accurate, and consistent with source systems.
Partner directly with Portfolio Managers, Traders, Risk professionals, Data teams, and business stakeholders to understand analytical workflows and reporting requirements.
Support user acceptance testing, production validation, release activities, and ongoing production support.
Develop reusable BI and data-engineering patterns that improve delivery consistency and maintainability.

Support entitlement and access-control requirements for sensitive investment and financial information.
Document solution architecture, source-to-target mappings, data models, MicroStrategy objects, reporting logic, operational procedures, and support requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve the user experience through analytics automation, AI-assisted development, and natural-language interaction with trusted investment data.
Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools where appropriate to accelerate SQL development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and analytical solution design.

Required Skills and Experience

7–10+ years of professional experience across Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or enterprise data platforms.
Strong hands-on experience developing enterprise solutions using MicroStrategy.
Experience building and maintaining: Reports, Dashboards / Dossiers, Metrics, Attributes, Facts, Hierarchies, Filters, Prompts, Transformations, Semantic / Metadata layers.
Strong understanding of MicroStrategy architecture and administration concepts, including how BI applications interact with databases, semantic models, caches, and reporting services.

Strong experience designing relational, dimensional, and analytical data models.

Strong experience within Asset Management, Investment Management, Capital Markets, or another complex financial-data environment.

title: Data Automation Engineer / Analyst – Global Investment Fund – 250k+
description:
About the Role

A multi-strategy investment fund is hiring an engineer to sit at the point where software engineering and data work meet. The role builds the automation that removes manual process from the middle of the business, the reporting layer that investment and operations teams rely on, and the tooling that turns recurring analytical requests into systems nobody has to think about again. The work touches performance reporting, position and P&L data, and the operational flows that have to be right before the market opens. Every manual spreadsheet step this role eliminates is a source of error and a person's morning returned to them, and the fund treats that as real value rather than housekeeping.




What You'll Do

Build and own Python based automation that replaces manual and semi manual processes across investment and operations teams
Write and optimise complex SQL against large datasets, and own the data models behind reporting
Design the reporting and analytics layer that business users depend on daily, including dashboards and self service tooling
Sit with stakeholders across the front and middle office to find processes worth automating, then deliver them end to end
Apply real engineering discipline to data work: version control, testing, code review, deployment, monitoring




Must-haves

3 to 8 years of experience across software development and data or analytics engineering
Strong Python, written to production standard rather than script standard. This is non-negotiable, the role needs genuine developer depth
Advanced SQL, including query optimisation and data modelling
A track record of building automation that replaced a manual process and stayed in production
Comfort working directly with business stakeholders and turning loose requirements into working systems




Nice-to-haves

BI tooling experience (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation and orchestration frameworks
Cloud data warehouse experience (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
Exposure to financial data: P&L, positions, returns, risk
Experience in a multi-strategy or multi-asset environment




Why This Role

This is a hybrid profile that most firms handle badly, splitting it between a developer who does not understand the data and an analyst who cannot ship code. This fund wants one person who does both, and gives that person the autonomy to decide what gets automated. The structure is flat, the feedback loop from build to impact is measured in days, and the work is visible to senior people across the business. For an engineer who is happiest when their code quietly deletes somebody's recurring problem, and who wants the data fluency to know which problem to delete, this is that.




Who should apply

Candidates coming from either direction are welcome: developers who have moved toward data, and BI or analytics engineers who have built real software. No finance background required.

title: Sr Manager Analytics Engineer
description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Sr. Manager Analytics Engineer, Content Data

Req - 46420

Overview And Responsibilities

Paramount Streaming is a division of Paramount that encompasses both free, paid, and premium streaming services including Paramount+ and Pluto TV.

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG) team.

DIG is a key connector among the Paramount Streaming verticals. The group includes experts who create and improve data systems and products. They evaluate, combine, and analyze data. They develop insights and stories from both qualitative and quantitative data. Their work helps stakeholders make decisions. It also helps them understand performance and receive business recommendations.

Role Details

In this important role, you will develop and maintain scalable data pipelines. You will build reliable core business reasoning. You will ensure high data quality standards for content metadata. This includes titles, rights, taxonomy, and catalog data that support Paramount's streaming business.

You will work closely with analysts, data engineers, content operations, programming, licensing, and product teams. Your goal is to convert basic metadata feeds and content data into reliable datasets, dashboards, and insights. These will support decision-making for Paramount+, Pluto TV, and other Paramount streaming services.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics and wants to drive data excellence at scale. This role has people management responsibilities.

Responsibilities

Pipeline Ownership: Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines. These pipelines will manage content metadata like titles, rights and licensing windows, genres, talent, franchise or series hierarchies, and availability. You will work with data engineering and analytics teams. Content Metadata Modeling: Develop and improve reliable data models. These models will unify content metadata from different sources. This includes ingest, catalog management, licensing, and rights management systems. They will support detailed reporting. This reporting will be at the title, franchise, and window levels.

Data Quality: Collaborate with software and data engineering teams. Make sure the metadata is complete, precise, and consistent. This involves identifying issues such as duplicate titles, missing or conflicting rights windows, incorrect genre or talent tagging, and misclassified territories.

Performance Monitoring: Contribute to anomaly detection systems and operational dashboards that track content catalog health, metadata completeness, and data quality KPIs. Collaboration across functions is important. You will work closely with analysts. Collaborate with content operations, programming teams, licensing, and product managers. You will translate business needs into technical data solutions. Tooling & Enablement: Build scalable, performant datasets in platforms such as Databricks, Looker, and Snowflake to enable self-service analytics for content stakeholders. Documentation & Standards: Lead the creation and maintenance of clear technical documents. Set coding standards and practices for data governance. Focus on metadata taxonomy standards and ensure compliance with content rights.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in economics, Statistics, Analytics, Computer Science, MIS, Data Engineering, or related field. 7+ years of experience in analytical engineering, data engineering, or data analytics with solid SQL and data modeling expertise.

Deep knowledge of ETL/ELT principles, data architecture, and performance optimization. Proven experience building scalable data products and pipelines using tools such as Databricks, Airflow, Spark, or similar platforms. You should have direct experience with modeling and maintaining content metadata pipelines. This includes working with title catalogs, rights and windowing data. You should also be acquainted with genre and talent taxonomies, or similar structured data in entertainment or media. Proficient ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver high-impact data solutions.

Fluency in building and maintaining production-grade datasets in cloud-based data environments (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery). Proficiency with BI tools such as Looker and Tableau, including building curated data layers and performance tuning. Solid data hygiene practices, including version control, code reviews, unit testing, and documentation. Exemplary problem-solving skills and attention to detail, especially when reconciling metadata inconsistencies across systems.

Additional Qualifications

Experience working with content rights and licensing data, including availability windows, territory restrictions, and content lifecycle management. Knowledge with content taxonomy and classification systems used in entertainment or media. Proficiency in Python or another scripting language for data transformation or orchestration.

Knowledge with streaming media or direct-to-consumer digital products.

Experience implementing anomaly detection systems or contributing to root cause investigations for metadata issues. Knowledge of data governance and compliance best practices as they relate to licensed content.

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

What We Offer:

Strong analytical skills, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.

o9 Solutions certification or advanced technical training.
